# Anaibo

> Anaibo is a hyperlocal online grocery delivery service based in Chattogram, Bangladesh, offering 1500+ products with Cash on Delivery within a 2-mile radius.

Anaibo lets customers browse and order everyday grocery items — fresh produce, packaged goods, household essentials, and more — for fast local delivery from a family-run store.

## Pages

- [Home](https://anaibo.com/): Featured products, best sellers, and store highlights.
- [All Items](https://anaibo.com/collection): Full product catalog with search and filtering.
- [Cart](https://anaibo.com/cart): Customer shopping cart.
- [Orders](https://anaibo.com/orders): Order history and tracking.
- [Contact](https://anaibo.com/contact): Contact information and support.

## Notes

- Delivery is limited to a 2-mile radius around the store location in Chattogram, Bangladesh.
- Payment is Cash on Delivery only.
